title: The relationship between tourism, economic growth and environmental sustainability: empirical evidence from major tourist destinations
core_idea: Examine the causal links among tourism activity, economic growth and environmental sustainability (CO2 emissions) for countries that ranked in the top 10 tourist destinations during 1995–2023 using a less-common CS-ARDL technique.
tldr: Investigates relationships and causality between tourism, economic growth and environmental impact (CO2) across top tourism destinations (1995–2023) employing the CS-ARDL method to provide empirical evidence for policy consideration.
